user_id.description: The unique identifier of the user. This is the primary key.

wins.description: Total number of rounds the user has won.

database.instructions: This database stores the total number of wins for each user in the Pimple Popper game. To update a user's win count, upsert a record into the 'leaderboard' collection with the user's ID as the 'id' and their new total wins.
